en.headline: The Gruffalo plays two more shows at APA today
en.dek: Tall Stories' hour-long English musical of the Julia Donaldson picture book continues at the Wan Chai campus this afternoon, with a second weekend next week.
body: Tall Stories' stage version of The Gruffalo has two performances left this weekend at the Rita Tong Liu Drama Theatre of the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts in Wan Chai, at 11am and 2pm on Sunday. A second block of shows runs from 11 to 13 September.

The production is a musical adaptation of the picture book by Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler, following Mouse through the deep dark wood. The presenters are ABA Productions, Tall Stories of the United Kingdom and CDP Kids Productions of Australia. The company said the show is marking 25 years on stage; ABA first brought it to Hong Kong in 2009.

The running time is about 60 minutes with no interval. Performances are in English and are aimed at children aged three and above and their families. The academy said there is no minimum age, but every audience member must have a ticket.

Tickets are sold through Cityline at HK$475, HK$425, HK$375 and HK$275 for restricted-view seats. Group rates apply when six or more standard tickets are bought in one transaction. The venue is the APA campus on Gloucester Road, Wan Chai.

zh.headline: 《咕噜牛》今日在演藝學院尚有兩場
zh.dek: 根據朱莉娅唐納森繪本改編的英語音樂劇今早十一時及下午二時在灣仔演藝學院上演，下周末十一至十三日還有第二輪場次。
body: 英國劇團Tall Stories的舞台版《咕噜牛》（The Gruffalo）本周末在灣仔香港演藝學院廖湯慧藾戲劇院尚餘兩場，今日上午十一時及下午二時開演。第二輪場次訂於九月十一日至十三日。
製作改編自朱莉娅唐納森與阿克塞爾謝弗勒的繪本，講述小老鼠走過深黑樹林的故事。主辦為ABA Productions、英國Tall Stories及澳洲CDP Kids Productions。主辦指今年適逢作品登上舞台二十五周年；ABA於二零零九年首次把劇目帶到香港。
演出長約六十分鐘，沒有中場休息，以英語進行，對象為三歲或以上兒童及家人。學院表示不設最低年齡，但每名進場人士均須持票。
門票經Cityline發售，票價四百七十五元、四百二十五元、三百七十五元，以及限制視線座位二百七十五元。一次過購買六張或以上正價票可享團體價。場地為灣仔告士打道演藝學院校園。
